name: security-gift-card-ledger-review
intent: Funded issuance and transferable bearer gift-card value lifecycle
artifacts: Card issuance/redemption state, balance ledger, recipient binding and owned payment sandbox.
trace: Trace each benefit to its authoritative debit/credit and eligibility rule, including partial redemption, rollback and refunded issuance.
experiment: Use synthetic funding, activation and transfer entries for one test card, then redeem and reverse under the owner policy. Compare spendable issuance against funding/promotional authority and ensure the same debit/transfer is not counted twice.
disproof: A displayed balance change is not additional spendable value; verify ledger and redemption authority, not UI arithmetic.
repair: Preserve value conservation and atomic redemption, then test legitimate partial use, replay rejection and rollback.
branch_decisions: Track issued, available, reserved, redeemed and refunded value separately. An optimistic balance may later reconcile without permitting extra spend. Show two authoritative debits/credits or another forbidden benefit under the same eligibility rule before classifying a duplicate-redemption defect.
operational_method: Specialize in the funded issuance and transferable bearer-card lifecycle. Retain funding/capture, activation, transfer, redemption and reversal entries for one synthetic instrument; separate deliberately unfunded promotional value. Verify issued spendable value against authorized funding/credit and track the owner of each debit when a card changes hands. Knowing a display code is not proof of a valid bearer secret or authority to redeem someone else card.
